May contain spoilers from Convocation **Source** [Rival Academies](/Sources.aspx?ID=235) pg. 71 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 creature **Defense** Fortitude **Duration** varies --- Many stories tell of a clearing deep in the Mwangi jungle, surrounded by ancient cypress trees. At the center stands an ancient baobab tree growing around a large sphere of black basalt. Legends say that two spirit brothers, Ranage and Golokango, dwelled there long ago until Golokango’s evil ways forced the virtuous Ranage to encase his brother in stone. Ranage then transformed himself into a tree to surround and protect the rock for all time. By telling this tale, you condemn an enemy to a stony fate similar to Golokango’s and summon plants to surround them. When you Cast this Spell, every square adjacent to the target becomes [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) from the sudden eruption of plant life for 1 minute. The target also attempts a Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 as their feet are bound within stone. This condition lasts until they move from their current position.
**Failure** The target is clumsy 2 and [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) as their legs are encased in rock. The clumsy condition lasts until they move from their current position, and they can [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) from being immobilized with a check against your spell DC.
**Critical Failure** The target is clumsy 2 and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) as nearly their entire body is covered in basalt. The clumsy condition lasts until they move from their current position, and they can Escape from being restrained with a successful check against your spell DC.

<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Rapid Adaptation](/Spells.aspx?ID=979)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 124

**Tradition**
[Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** your companion or eidolon
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You flood the target with energy from the terrain around it, compressing centuries of evolution into a single moment. The target gains one of the following natural adaptations based on the surrounding environment.

- **Aquatic** The target gains a swim Speed equal to its land Speed. If it already had a swim Speed, it gains a +10-foot status bonus to its swim Speed.
- **Arctic** The target isn't affected by [severe or extreme cold](/Rules.aspx?ID=642), and when it rolls a success on an [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) check to [Balance](/Actions.aspx?ID=28) on ice and snow, it gets a critical success instead.
- **Desert** The target isn't affected by severe or extreme heat, and when it rolls a success on an Acrobatics check to Balance on sand, it gets a critical success instead.
- **Forest** The target gains [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) as an [imprecise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) with a range of 30 feet.
- **Mountain** The target isn't [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) when [Climbing](/Actions.aspx?ID=33), and when it rolls a success on an Acrobatics check to Balance on rubble, it gets a critical success instead.
- **Plains** The target gains a +10-foot status bonus to its land Speed.
- **Underground** The target gains [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).

</row>

---

You evoke [Zevgavizeb’s](/Deities.aspx?ID=82) unceasing hunger and inflict it upon your target. The target becomes overwhelmed with cannibalistic hunger and can restore its vitality by feasting on the flesh of the fallen. On its turn, the target can use 2 actions (these actions have the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) trait) to cannibalize an adjacent dying or dead creature. If the cannibalized creature is [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11), it dies. If the cannibalized creature is an ally of the target, the target regains 5d8 HP; otherwise, the target regains 5d4 HP. Certain monsters (such as those whose blood is acidic or magical) might inflict additional effects on those who cannibalize them at the GM’s discretion. Once cannibalized, a particular creature’s body doesn’t have enough meat to cannibalize again. During any round that there’s a dying or dead creature within 30 feet of the target, if the target can’t or doesn’t cannibalize a creature, the target takes 5d4 mental damage.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The amount of HP restored by cannibalizing a creature increases by 1d8 for eating an ally and 1d4 otherwise, and the mental damage increases by 1d4.

</row>

---

You create a shroud of magical darkness that feeds on those inside it. This globe of pure darkness is identical to that created by a 4th-level [_darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=59) spell. Blunt, gnashing teeth made of shadows gnaw at the creatures within. Make a spell attack roll against the Fortitude DC of each creature in the area. Any creature that fails takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage as teeth attach to it. While the teeth are attached, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds and can't Step. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the area, the teeth attempt to attach to that creature if they haven't already, and they deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage to any creature they're already attached to. The shadowy teeth become unattached from any creature that leaves the area but can't otherwise be detached from a creature while that creature remains in the area. You can Dismiss the spell.

<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Ravenous Portal](/Spells.aspx?ID=980)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 124

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 door no more than 10 feet tall and 5 feet wide
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You place a ward upon the door that triggers when a creature attempts to open, unlock, or destroy the door. When that happens, the door transforms into a [mimic](/Monsters.aspx?ID=300) that can't move and is [hostile](/Conditions.aspx?ID=23) to all creatures. When Casting the Spell, you designate yourself and up to 10 other creatures of your choice; these creatures don't trigger the ward, and the mimic is [helpful](/Conditions.aspx?ID=21) to them instead of hostile. No effect can move the mimic unless it's also capable of moving the entire door. Once the door transforms into a mimic, it attacks creatures in its reach for up to 1 minute, and then the spell ends. If the mimic is killed before that time, the spell ends and the door returns to its normal form.

 While turned into a mimic, the door can't be opened, unlocked, or bypassed—not even by the designated creatures. It's a creature, not a door, during that time. When the spell ends, the door returns to the state it was in before the ward was triggered.

fields.text: Cantrip 1 Read Aura Cantrip Concentrate Detection Manipulate Source Player Core pg. 352 Traditions Arcane, Divine, Occult, Primal Spell Lists Elemental Mystery Lore Cast 1 minute Range 30 feet Target 1 object You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell. Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects. Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 362

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

[Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5)

**Bloodline**
[Wyrmblessed](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=17)

**Mystery**
[Lore](/Mysteries.aspx?ID=7)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute ([somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284))

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 object
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the [school of magic](/Rules.aspx?ID=261).

 If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the level of your _read aura_ spell.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** You can target up to 10 objects.

**Heightened (6th)** You can target any number of objects.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Prediction" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=132" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 375

**Domain**
[Fate](/Domains.aspx?ID=75)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature other than you
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You attempt to learn more about the target's fate in the short term, usually within the next day for most prosaic creatures, or the next hour or less for someone likely to have multiple rapid experiences, such as someone actively adventuring.

 You learn a single enigmatic word connected to the creature's fate in that time frame. Fate is notoriously inscrutable, and the word isn't necessarily meant to be taken at face value, so the meaning is often clear only in hindsight. The GM rolls a secret DC 6 flat check. If the creature's fate is too uncertain, or on a failed flat check, the spell yields the word “inconclusive.” Either way, the creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=550" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Subtle" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=522" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 159

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You survey a social situation, showing courtesy to all around you as your intuition swiftly picks up clues about social contexts and unspoken assumptions of behavior. Your body language subconsciously changes to take advantage of this information and use it in your own interactions with those creatures. As part of Casting this Spell, you [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) using [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47) to gain information about the social situation. You also gain a +1 status bonus to your next [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) check to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) on those creatures present when you Cast this Spell, as long as the check occurs during the duration of the spell. You can _read the air_ only once in a given social situation; casting it again has no effect.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 183 **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 of your thralls **Duration** 1 minute --- You launch a thrall up to 30 feet into the corpse of an enemy that has been dead for no more than 1 minute, destroying the thrall in an effort to call the corpse to fight. Attempt an [Undead Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) check against the standard DC of the level of enemy you’re trying to reanimate. You can reanimate only corpses of creatures that were once living or undead. **Success** The enemy reanimates in an unoccupied space adjacent to its corpse. It’s under your control and has the minion trait. It has the same attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 100 Hit Points and lacks all special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except the weapons and armor it used before death. Its Strikes deal the normal damage but don’t apply added effects since the creature doesn’t have special abilities. The reanimated foe is unstable and decays quickly. Each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 15 Hit Points. It can’t regain its lost Hit Points in any way. The reanimated creature lasts for 1 minute or until it’s reduced to 0 Hit Points.
**Failure** As success, but the reanimated enemy deals half damage with its Strikes and loses 50 Hit Points each turn instead of 15.
**Critical Failure** You create a thrall in the corpse’s space, but you don’t spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.

You call forth a ghostly lantern that guides the living toward death and the undead toward true death. It sheds bright light in the spell's area and dim light to twice that area. The lantern is insubstantial and floats near you, suspended from an ephemeral, skeletal hand. Living creatures and [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) in the area when you Cast the Spell, or that enter the area later, must attempt Fortitude saves. Living creatures that fail their Fortitude saves gain only half the normal benefit from [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623) effects while within the area. Undead targets that fail their Fortitude saves become [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) while within the area. Once a creature attempts a save against reaper's lantern, it uses the same outcome if it leaves the area and enters it again.

 Once per turn, starting on the round after you cast _reaper's lantern_, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet. When you do so, you force creatures in the area that haven't yet attempted a save against _reaper's lantern_ to attempt one.

You call forth a ghostly lantern that guides the living toward death and the undead toward true death. It sheds bright light in the spell's area, and dim light to twice that area. Though the lantern is insubstantial, you must keep a hand free to hold it or the spell ends (though using the hand for somatic spell components doesn't end the spell). Living creatures and [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) in the area when you Cast the Spell, or that enter the area later, must attempt Fortitude saves. Living creatures that fail their Fortitude saves gain only half the normal benefit from [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89) effects while within the area. Undead targets that fail their Fortitude saves become [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) while within the area. Once a creature attempts a save against _reaper's lantern_, it uses the same outcome if it leaves the area and enters it again.

 Once per turn, starting on the turn after you cast _reaper's lantern_, you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet. When you do so, you force creatures in the area that haven't yet attempted a save against _reaper's lantern_ to attempt one.

**Target** 1 willing creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration**  Until the target’s next daily preparations

---

You establish a mental link with the target, focusing on a piece of knowledge important to their culture, family (by birth or choice), or home settlement. Both you and the target must be aware this knowledge exists, even if you don’t know the exact details. As your magic connects them to this legacy, the target gains a non-lineage ancestry feat from their ancestry. The feat must be of a level no higher than twice _recall legacy’s_ rank and the target must meet any prerequisites for the feat. The target is then immune to any further castings of recall legacy until their next daily preparations.

Whether it’s your spellbook, a reagent, or a glass of wine, it’s simply more efficient to call it to your hand. You teleport the target into your open hand. If you don’t have a hand free, it falls to the ground at your feet. Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less. <title level="1" right="Focus 7" pfs="Standard">
[Recurring Nightmare](/Spells.aspx?ID=2906)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Necromancer" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=950" />
<trait label="Thrall" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=955" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 184

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Will

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You conjure forth a ghostly thrall that isn’t easily slain. You create a thrall within range, and you can create it in a space occupied by a creature. Unlike other thralls, the nightmare can share its space with other creatures, and other creatures can move through its space with ease. If this thrall is summoned into or ends its movement in a creature’s space, the creature must succeed at a Will saving throw or become [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1 (or frightened 2 on a critical failure); this is an [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effect. The thrall has a [fly Speed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) of 60 feet and remains airborne at the end of your turn even if it didn’t [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) that turn. Any ability you use that would make the thrall [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) allows it to Fly instead. The thrall’s Strikes deal void damage and must target a creature in the thrall’s space. When you use _thrall charge_ to order this thrall to make a Strike, that Strike deals an additional 2d6 damage. If the thrall has been destroyed, you can Sustain this spell to resummon the thrall. You can do this only once per round.

---
**Heightened (8th)** The additional damage increases to 3d6.

---

You strike mention of a specific name from one or more documents. When you [Cast the Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734), give one proper name, be it a creature, location, or object. Any mention of that name within the document becomes blurred, smudged, or otherwise completely illegible. Epithets and unambiguous references to the name are redacted as well; for instance, redacting the name of the goddess [Sarenrae](/Deities.aspx?ID=292) from a book would also remove references to her title “the Dawnflower.” Attempts to use this reference material to [Recall Knowledge](/Rules.aspx?ID=2638) about the given proper name automatically fail.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** Instead of striking out a given name, you can replace it with a different name you choose. Epithets and references are substituted with similar ones relating to the replacement name. Anyone reading the text can attempt a Perception or Society check against your spell DC to notice the altered text, though that doesn’t tell them what the original said.

**Heightened (4th)** At your choice, the duration is unlimited.

<title level="1" right="Cantrip 5" pfs="Standard">
[Redistribute Potential](/Spells.aspx?ID=1138)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Psychic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=430" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 20

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Area** 2 adjacent 5-foot squares

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Saving Throw** 
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude

</row>

</column>

---

Energy attempts to balance out, but with your magic, you can shunt all the energy in one area to another. Creatures in either area take 4d4 damage with a basic Fortitude save. Choose one of the squares to steal heat, dealing cold damage, and the other to concentrate the stolen heat, dealing fire damage. A creature that fails its save also becomes [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) from numbness if it's in the area of stolen heat or [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) from heat stroke if it's in the area of concentrated heat; these conditions last until the start of your next turn. If a creature is large enough to be in both squares, you choose only one of the areas for it to attempt its save against; it's unaffected by the other area.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

---

<column gap="tiny">
**Amp** You can affect the flow of energy on a much grander scale. Instead of two 5-foot squares, you create two 10-foot bursts. They still must be adjacent to one another and can overlap. A creature in both areas can still be affected by only one of your choice. The spell's damage increases to 6d6. The conditions last for 1 minute.

**Amp Heightened (+1)**
Increase the damage by 2d6 instead of 1d4.
</column>

When you cast _reflected beauty_, choose a willing creature that’s the same size as you and that you can see within 30 feet. The spell then disguises you with a realistic illusion, as if via [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) heightened to 3rd rank, but includes tactile and olfactory sensation in addition to visual and voice. The appearance of the illusion that disguises you includes any changes to sex characteristics or other aspects needed to match the target creature’s heart’s desire, allowing you to interact with them as the person they could be. If you’re ever more than 30 feet from the subject you’re reflecting, _reflected beauty_ immediately ends. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) this spell.

<row gap="medium">

You grow a set of colored, glowing scales or scaled armor that stores energy before releasing it in a final burst. When you cast this spell, choose [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524), [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586), or [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) damage. You gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) 5 against that type of damage. The scales’ color depends on the damage type you chose, such as red or orange for fire damage.

The scales store up energy as they protect you. Keep track of how much damage the scales have prevented. As a 2-action activity that has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) and [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) traits, you can explode your scales outward in a 20-foot emanation, dealing 1d6 damage of the chosen type to all creatures in the area for every 10 damage the scales have prevented, to a maximum of 10d6 damage (after preventing 100 damage). Each creature in the area must attempt a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2247) Reflex save. Once you do so, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 5, and the maximum damage from the scale explosion increases by 5d6.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 352

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 willing living creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

An infusion of vital energy grants a creature continuous healing. The target temporarily gains [regeneration](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=26) 15, which restores 15 Hit Points to it at the start of each of its turns. While it has regeneration, the target can't die from taking Hit Point damage and its [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11) condition can't increase to a value that would kill it (this stops most creatures' dying condition at dying 3), though if its [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=42) value becomes 4 or higher, it stays [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) until its wounds are treated. If the target takes acid or fire damage, its regeneration deactivates until after the end of its next turn.

 Each time the creature regains Hit Points from regeneration, it also regrows one damaged or ruined organ (if any). During the spell's duration, the creature can also reattach severed body parts by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

---
**Heightened (9th)** The regeneration increases to 20.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 352

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Spell Lists**
[Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 hour

**Cost** a remnant of the item

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 5 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You fully re-create an object from nothing, even if the object was destroyed. To do so, you must be able to picture the object in your mind. The remnant of the item can be small or insignificant (even a speck of dust that remains from [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) is enough). The spell fails if your imagination relied on too much guesswork; if the object would be too large to fit in a 5-foot cube; if the object still exists and you were simply not aware of it; or if the object is an artifact, has a level over 20, or has similar vast magical power.

 The item reassembles in perfect condition. Even if your mental image was of a damaged or weathered object, the new one is in this perfected form. If the object was [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), this spell typically restores its constant magical properties, but not any temporary ones, such as charges or one-time uses. An item with charges or uses per day has all of its uses expended when remade, but it replenishes them normally thereafter.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 159 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** touch **Target** 1 living creature **Defense** Fortitude **Duration** varies --- At your touch, the target's body shifts and transmutes into random mismatched animal parts, such as [crab](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=577) claws for hands and mismatched gazelle and [gorilla](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2827) legs. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.
  • Due to the unbalanced body weight and mismatched limbs, the target takes a –20-foot status penalty to its Speeds.
  • The creature's mind and body no longer align, making it [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), and [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94).
  • The target's new eyes make depth perception difficult; the target becomes [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65).
  • Whenever the target would regain actions at the start of its turn, it must first attempt a DC 5 [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=333); on a failure, it's [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for a round.
**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is affected for 1 round.
**Failure** The target is affected for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The effect is permanent.

<title level="1" right="Focus 4" pfs="Standard">
[Remember the Lost](/Spells.aspx?ID=2420)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=26" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=106" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Divine Mysteries](/Sources.aspx?ID=234) pg. 271

**Domain**
[Vigil](/Domains.aspx?ID=123)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387)

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You call upon the lost and forgotten, assailing your foes’ minds with the memories of those who died with a grievance toward them. Enemies in the area take 6d6 [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) damage (basic Will save) and are [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1 on a critical failure. If you know the names of anyone murdered or grievously wronged by an enemy in the area, you can chant those victims’ names when you [Cast the Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) to improve the clarity of the visions, increasing the damage to the corresponding enemy from 6d6 to 6d10; you can do so for multiple enemies if you know specific victims of each enemy. The visions are personal to each foe in the area, and you can’t use this spell to discern a murderer by guessing a name. A creature that truly knows no one who died with any sort of grievance to that creature is [immune](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) to this effect.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6 (or 2d10 to an enemy when you name a specific victim).

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 willing or unconscious creature of 8th level or lower
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained
</row>

</column>

---

You create an illusory magical double that physically looks and behaves very similarly to the target. This double is limited to moving, Interacting, speaking short sentences, and other similar basic tasks. It is unable to cast spells, attack, or use any complex skills.

 The illusory duplicate is your [minion](/Traits.aspx?ID=109). You can issue new commands to the double as part of Sustaining the Spell. You can command the duplicate telepathically as long as the spell lasts, provided it's within 1 mile of you. You can switch between using your own senses and the duplicate's senses with a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait. The illusory duplicate has the same statistics as the original creature, except it doesn't have any of the original's item bonuses, and it has one quarter of the original's Hit Points. If the double's Hit Points are reduced to 0, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The maximum level of the target increases by 2.

Once a creature has attempted the save, it uses the same result for that casting of _repulsion_. </column>

---

Restorative magic counters the effects of toxins or conditions that prevent a creature from functioning at its best. When you cast _restoration_, choose to either reduce a condition or lessen the effect of a toxin. A creature can benefit from only one _restoration_ spell each day, and it can't benefit from _restoration_ more than once to reduce the stage of the same exposure to a given toxin.

- **Reduce a Condition** Reduce the value of the target's clumsy, enfeebled, or stupefied condition by 2. You can instead reduce two of the listed conditions by 1 each.
- **Lessen a Toxin** Reduce the stage of one toxin the target suffers from by one stage. This can't reduce the stage below stage 1 or cure the affliction.

---
**Heightened (4th)** Add drained to the list of conditions you can reduce. When you lessen a toxin, reduce the stage by two. You also gain a third option that allows you to reduce the target's doomed value by 1. You can't use this to reduce a permanent doomed condition.

**Heightened (6th)** As the 4th-level _restoration_, but you can reduce a permanent doomed condition if you add a spellcasting action and a material component while Casting the Spell, during which you provide 100 gp worth of diamond dust as a cost.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 159 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Range** 120 feet **Target** 1 creature touching or standing on a solid surface **Duration** 1 minute --- A steel chain materializes from the surface, fettered to one space of your choice that the target occupies, weaving itself around the creature’s limbs. The chain continuously pulls on the target and impedes its movement. The chain has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 30 Hit Points, and it’s immune to critical hits and precision damage. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target can only move up to 20 feet away from where the chains are fettered until the chains are broken or the target [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296).
**Failure** The target is [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 and can only move up to 10 feet away from where the chains are fettered until the chains are broken or the target Escapes.
**Critical Failure** The chain binds the target tighter. The target is clumsy 2 and can only move up to 5 feet away from where the chains are fettered until the chains are broken or the target Escapes.

---

You permanently change the appearance of one piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally to better fit your aesthetic sensibilities. You can change its color, texture, pattern, and other minor parts of its design, but the changes can’t alter the clothing’s overall shape, size, or purpose. The changes can’t increase the quality of the craftsmanship or artistry of the piece of clothing, but particularly gauche choices for the new color and pattern might decrease its aesthetic appeal. This spell transforms existing materials into the desired appearance and never alters the material or creates more material than what’s originally part of the object. The object’s statistics also remain unchanged.

[Amaznen](/Deities.aspx?ID=404), [Atrogine](/Deities.aspx?ID=331), [Phlegyas](/Deities.aspx?ID=546), [Pillars of Knowledge](/Deities.aspx?ID=209), [Rivethun](/Deities.aspx?ID=388), [Stone's Blood](/Deities.aspx?ID=382), [Surveyors of the Deep](/Deities.aspx?ID=731), [Teki Stronggut](/Deities.aspx?ID=505), [Yluma](/Deities.aspx?ID=721), [Zohls](/Deities.aspx?ID=489)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained
</row>

</column>

---

Opening your mind to mental echoes, you gain impressions from past events that occurred in your current location. _Retrocognition_ reveals psychic impressions from events that occurred over the course of the last day throughout the first minute of the duration, followed by impressions from the next day back the next minute, and so on. These echoes don't play out like a vision but instead reveal impressions of emotions and metaphors that provide cryptic clues and details of the past. If you witness a traumatic or turbulent event through an impression, the spell ends unless you succeed at a Will save with a DC of at least 30 and possibly as much as 50, depending on the severity of the event. The GM determines whether an event is traumatic and chooses the DC.

---
**Heightened (8th)** You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous year for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it harder to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.

**Heightened (9th)** You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous century for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it almost impossible to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.

<title level="1" right="Spell 5" pfs="">
[Return Beacon](/Spells.aspx?ID=848)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Fists of the Ruby Phoenix</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Teleportation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=156" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #166: Despair on Danger Island](/Sources.aspx?ID=85) pg. 77

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute ([material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284))

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You create a unique planar beacon somewhere within the spell's range that remains in place. The beacon is invisible except when detected by [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), in which case it looks like a 10-foot-wide tower of bright light stretching into the sky. At any time during the duration of the beacon, you can complete a 1-minute activity, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) and [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) traits, to focus on the beacon and transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to the location of the beacon. Transporting yourself in this way ends the spell. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an [extradimensional](/Traits.aspx?ID=67) container—the beacon collapses, ending the spell, and the transportation attempt fails.

 Casting _return beacon_ while a beacon is active causes the previous _return beacon_ spell to end. If you are not within 1 mile of the beacon, your attempt to transport yourself to the beacon fails. If a solid object is in the same space as the beacon when you transport yourself, you arrive in the nearest open space to the beacon. If there is not an open space within 30 feet of the beacon, your attempt to transport yourself fails, but the beacon remains intact.

---
**Heightened (7th)** The duration is 8 hours and you can transport yourself to the beacon from up to 100 miles away.

**Heightened (8th)** The duration is 24 hours and you can transport yourself to the beacon from up to 1,000 miles away. In addition, you can bring 1 willing ally you touch with you when you transport to the beacon.

**Heightened (9th)** The duration is 1 week and you can transport yourself to the beacon from anywhere on the same plane. In addition, you can bring up to 4 willing allies you touch with you when you transport to the beacon.

**Heightened (10th)** The duration is unlimited and you can transport yourself to the beacon from any distance, even across other planes. In addition, you can bring up to 8 willing allies you touch when you transport to the beacon.

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star](/Sources.aspx?ID=103) pg. 77

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Target** one magically sealed or warded doorway or chest
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You unravel the magic of a spell that affects a container, door, or lock, converting it into energy you can repurpose to power your own spells. Attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against the target spell or magical effect that wards or seals a doorway or chest, such as [_lock_](/Spells.aspx?ID=174), or against a spell or effect that deals damage or delivers secondary effects when it's opened, such as [_glyph of warding_](/Spells.aspx?ID=138). If you succeed, you recover its energy, restoring one of your expended spell slots of 3rd level or lower.

---
**Heightened (8th)** You can restore an expended spell slot of 4th level or lower.

**Heightened (9th)** You can restore an expended spell slot of 5th level or lower.

**Heightened (10th)** You can restore an expended spell slot of 6th level or lower.

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 353 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Spell Lists** [Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5) **Range** 120 feet **Area** 10-foot burst **Defense** Reflex **Duration** varies --- A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7). If the creature was [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), it becomes [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Deity**
[Otolmens](/Deities.aspx?ID=145)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Area** 20-foot radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You reverse gravity in the area. Creatures and objects that aren't secured to the ground immediately fall upward to the top of the area. A creature might be able to Grab an Edge to arrest its fall if it falls past an appropriate surface. If a creature falls against a solid object (such as a ceiling), it takes the appropriate amount of falling damage and lands on the surface. Once an object or creature reaches the top of the area, it floats, caught between the normal and reversed gravity. The creature can move along the plane where the two forms of gravity meet. Creatures that can levitate or fly can use those abilities to mitigate the effects of _reverse gravity_.

When _reverse gravity_ ends, all creatures and objects caught in the area fall back down. Likewise, anything that moves beyond the spell's area is subjected to normal gravity again.

**Target** dead creatures and living creatures of your choice within range
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

A burst of healing energy soothes living creatures and temporarily rouses those recently slain. All living targets regain 10d8+40 Hit Points. You return any number of dead targets to life temporarily, with the same effects and limitations as [_raise dead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=243). The raised creatures have a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points you gave living creatures, but no normal Hit Points. The raised creatures can't regain Hit Points or gain temporary Hit Points in other ways, and once _revival's_ duration ends, they lose all temporary Hit Points and die. _Revival_ can't resurrect creatures killed by [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) or a [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effect. It has no effect on [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160).

 If the anchor space is occupied when you attempt to return to it or if this spell would bring another creature with you, the spell fails to transport you, then ends.

---

You continually glimpse into the target's future and nudge fate to guide them toward the best possible outcome. **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 366 **Tradition** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) **Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Requirements** You have a deity. **Duration** 1 minute --- You focus all your divine energy and transform yourself into a Medium battle form, similar to your normal form but armed with powerful divine armaments granted by your deity. While in this form, you gain the statistics and abilities listed below. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities:
  • AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 10 temporary Hit Points.
  • Speed 40 feet.
  • Resistance 3 against physical damage.
  • Darkvision.
  • A special attack with a righteous armament version of your favored weapon, which is the only attack you can use. Your attack modifier with the special weapon is +21, and your damage bonus is +8 (or +6 for a ranged attack). If your attack modifier with your deity's favored weapon is higher, you can use it instead. You deal three of your weapon's normal damage dice, or three damage dice of one size larger if your weapon is a simple weapon with a d4 or d6 damage die. The weapon has one of the following properties that matches your deity's alignment: _anarchic_, _axiomatic_, _holy_, _unholy_. If your deity is true neutral, you instead deal an extra 1d6 precision damage.
  • Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.

You call down a chill wind. When you Cast this Spell, you deal 2d4 cold damage to each creature in the area (basic Reflex save). If a creature in the area critically fails its Reflex save and was standing, it also falls [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).

 You also create a layer of ice on all surfaces in the area, which become difficult terrain. Unattended objects in the area become slick with ice, and picking them up requires a successful Reflex save or [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) check against your spell DC. **Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 354 **Traditions** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Lesson** [Lesson of Vows](/Lessons.aspx?ID=32) **Range** 30 feet **Area** 20-foot burst **Defense** Will **Duration** 10 minutes --- You designate an area in which lies are revealed. Creatures in the area also take a –2 status penalty to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks. Each time a creature in the area speaks a true statement, the soft ring of a bell sounds in the area. Creatures are aware of the magic; therefore, they can avoid answering questions to which they would normally respond with a lie, or they can be evasive as long as they remain within the boundaries of the truth. If a creature is in the area when the spell is cast or later enters the area, that creature attempts a Will save. It uses the results of this initial save if it leaves and reenters the area. **Critical Success** The target is so convincing that the bell rings even if they lie.
**Success** If the target lies and succeeds at their Deception check against all targets, the bell still rings.
**Failure** The bell accurately sees through their deception and will never ring if they lie.

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

---

Your apparition solidifies around you into roaring water and spraying mist. For the duration of this spell, you have [lesser cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372) against ranged attacks and gain a +10-foot status bonus to each Speed you have. When you first cast this spell and each time you Sustain it, you can Stride up to your speed while your apparition fills each square you pass through with the lingering energy of a coursing river. These squares become [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) until the start of your next turn. You can use river carving mountains while [Burrowing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2310), [Climbing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2374), [Flying](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312), or [Swimming](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

<title level="1" right="Spell 8" pfs="Standard">
[Roar Of Freedom](/Spells.aspx?ID=2941)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Sonic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=697" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Cheliax, Infernal Inheritence](/Sources.aspx?ID=372) pg. 128

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Will

</row>

</column>

---

You let out a furious roar, vowing never to be ruled by tyrants. Enemies within the emanation take 12d8 sonic damage and must attempt a Will save; particularly tyrannical creatures, like a despot or a devil, take a –2 circumstance penalty to their saves. The GM determines which creatures take this penalty. Allied creatures within the emanation gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage, is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1, and is [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, is frightened 2, and is stupefied 2 for 2 rounds.

</column>

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8, and the temporary Hit Points increase by 5.
